Hi Liam — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and direct answers to the items you raised around PII in prompts/outputs:

Short answers up front:
- Hosted API (default): raw prompts and generated outputs are retained in encrypted debug logs for 30 days by default; embeddings are retained for 90 days unless explicitly disabled.
- Dedicated: we can configure zero-log or short-retention profiles at the cluster level (customer-facing option).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): customer-managed; Redwood does not retain application-level prompts/outputs unless you opt-in.
- KV cache: ephemeral for the session and not persisted to durable storage by default.
- Data residency: EU tenant data is stored in our eu-west-1 region (Dublin) and stays within EU-located S3 buckets and databases.
- Access & controls: logs/audit exports are encrypted with customer-managed KMS on request; SOC 2 Type II in scope; DPA available.

Notes / clarifications you asked for:
- Can generated outputs be excluded from storage? Yes — for Dedicated and Private we support a "no-log" profile per route or API key.
- Can we disable embeddings storage? Yes, embeddings can be disabled or stored only in your VPC for Private deployments.
- What are the default retention windows? Prompts & outputs: 30 days; embeddings: 90 days; audit logs: 365 days (configurable).

Attachments: I attached a one-pager that summarizes PII handling and our retention matrix (data-retention-matrix.xlsx). Also included our Q3 security snapshot.

Next steps I propose:
1) Send over the one-pager + retention matrix (attached).
2) Set a security deep-dive with CardioTech security (we can include Aditya as SE).
3) If you want a zero-log profile we can scope a Dedicated configuration and include cost delta in the MAP.

Can you confirm which specific data types you want excluded (raw prompt, generated output, embeddings)? Once I have that I’ll draft the mutual action plan and loop in Legal for the DPA.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — great questions, answered inline below. Copying Aditya (SE) so he can own the tech deep-dive and security artifacts.

1) Storage format & access:
- Logs are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private. They are stored as encrypted objects; raw text is accessible to authorized Redwood SRE/Support under strict role-based access control and only for debugging with audit logs.
- We can implement tokenization/redaction hooks for specific fields before persisting when customers provide a schema.

2) Opt-out scope:
- Hosted: opt-out is at organization/account level (per billing account). We also support per-API-key logging toggles for customers on Dedicated.
- For Hosted accounts that need per-route behavior, we typically recommend migrating sensitive routes to a Dedicated pool to avoid impacting other workloads.

3) EU-only retention profile request (zero prompts, 7d outputs, embeddings disabled):
- Dedicated: fully support this profile; we will scope a cluster-level retention policy and an access-control review.
- Hosted: we can provide an account-level EU tenant profile with custom retention, but zero-prompt retention is typically done by routing those calls to a Dedicated pool or applying the no-log route. We can offer a Hosted-side short-term workaround (manual retention rule) while we migrate sensitive routes.

Attachments: I’ve re-attached the PII handling one-pager and retention matrix. Also adding the security snapshot for your team’s review.

Next steps:
- Aditya: can you prepare a short technical brief on how we would implement the zero-prompt + 7d outputs profile in EU (include any infra constraints and expected lead time)?
- Liam / CardioTech Security: propose two slots for the deep-dive and we’ll confirm availability.
- I’ll include the cost delta for a Dedicated zero-log profile in the MAP once Aditya confirms infra impacts.

Thanks — talk soon.
